headings.reviewNote: Mandating prominent lobby display of statutory application rules and notice of annual report availability.

headings.title: Twenty-five-month retention requirement for application records and rejected files
headings.reviewNote: Mandating 25-month file retention for all applications, unfee'd submissions, and segregated rejection files.

headings.title: Form approval and authorization of federally required application forms
headings.reviewNote: Subjecting institution forms to division disapproval and authorizing federally required documents.

headings.title: Mandatory application processing in at least one office per county
headings.reviewNote: Requiring deposit-taking institutions to process residential loan applications in at least one branch per county/city.

headings.title: Division rulemaking authority and section 536.024 requirement
headings.reviewNote: Permits division director rulemaking and makes chapter rules effective only if promulgated under section 536.024.

entries.reviewSummary: Reviewed all nine subsections and 1979–1995 history note; updated subsection 1 title to reflect both providing forms and accepting applications and subsection 9 title to include the chapter-wide section 536.024 rulemaking requirement.

headings.title: Preservation of sound underwriting practices based on creditworthiness and property value
headings.reviewNote: Clarifying sections do not require loans contrary to sound underwriting, applicant creditworthiness, and market value.

headings.title: Permissible procedural distinctions between new and previously occupied dwellings
headings.reviewNote: Permitting distinct application procedures for new dwelling construction vs previously occupied homes.

entries.reviewSummary: Reviewed both subsections and 1980 effective date; confirmed sound underwriting preservation (creditworthiness and market value) and new vs previously occupied dwelling procedure distinctions.

headings.title: Annual report to governor on violations and complaints in large jurisdictions
headings.reviewNote: Directing annual report to governor detailing lending violations, enforcement, and complaints in jurisdictions over 250,000.

headings.title: Five-year public maintenance requirement for annual division report
headings.reviewNote: Requiring division directors to maintain annual residential lending reports as public records for five years.

entries.reviewSummary: Reviewed both subsections, dual 2013 effective dates, and veto-override footnote for H.B. 329 (vetoed July 2, 2013; overridden Sept. 11, 2013; effective Oct. 11, 2013); confirmed annual report and 5-year public record headings.

headings.title: Regulatory division directors charged with enforcement across financial institutions
headings.reviewNote: Charging respective division directors and finance director with enforcement across state and federal institutions.

headings.title: Filing and investigation of discrimination complaints and hearing procedures
headings.reviewNote: Governing grievance filings, 90-day division determination, conciliation negotiations, and local hearing procedures.

headings.title: Administrative hearings and cease and desist orders for violations
headings.reviewNote: Establishing chapter 536 administrative hearings, cease and desist orders, and direct circuit court review.

headings.title: Injunctions and civil fines for violation of division director orders
headings.reviewNote: Authorizing injunctions and court fines prosecuted by attorney general for violations of final division orders.

headings.title: Remedies nonexclusive and cumulative to other individual remedies
headings.reviewNote: Establishing administrative enforcement remedies are nonexclusive and in addition to individual legal remedies.

entries.reviewSummary: Reviewed all five subsections, dual 2013 effective dates, and veto-override footnote for H.B. 329 (effective Oct. 11, 2013); confirmed division enforcement, 90-day complaint review, hearings, injunctions, and cumulative remedies.

headings.title: Missouri Right to Financial Privacy Act short title
headings.reviewNote: Establishes short title 'Missouri Right to Financial Privacy Act' for sections 408.675 to 408.700.

headings.title: Definitions of customer, financial institution, financial record, and related terms
headings.reviewNote: Defining customer, financial institution, financial record, government authority, subpoena, and related terms.

entries.reviewSummary: Reviewed both subsections and 1989 enactment note; tightened subsection 1 short-title heading and confirmed eight Missouri Right to Financial Privacy Act definitions.

headings.title: Prohibition against disclosing customer financial records to government authority
headings.reviewNote: Prohibiting financial institutions and personnel from providing record access to government authorities without compliance.

headings.title: Written certification of statutory compliance required before record release
headings.reviewNote: Prohibiting record release until government authority certifies in writing that it has complied with privacy statutes.

entries.reviewSummary: Reviewed both subsections and 1989 enactment note; confirmed government access prohibition and required written compliance notice before financial record release.

headings.title: Customer authorization requirements for disclosure of financial records
headings.reviewNote: Detailing signed customer authorization elements including period, revocability, record scope, purpose, and rights.

headings.title: Authorization not permitted as condition of doing business
headings.reviewNote: Prohibiting financial institutions from conditioning business on customer signing disclosure authorization.

headings.title: Customer right to inspect disclosures and identify receiving authority
headings.reviewNote: Establishing customer right to obtain copies of disclosed records and identify receiving government authorities.

entries.reviewSummary: Reviewed all three subsections and 1989 enactment note; confirmed signed customer authorization elements, bar on requiring authorization to do business, and customer copy/identity rights.

headings.title: Court order authorizing delay of customer notice on specified grounds
headings.reviewNote: Authorizing circuit court to delay notice upon finding evidence tampering, witness intimidation, or investigation jeopardy.

headings.title: Duration of delay order and prohibition on financial institution disclosure
headings.reviewNote: Limiting delay order up to 90 days, gagging financial institution, or allowing indefinite delay for physical safety.

headings.title: Ninety-day extensions of notice delay upon court application
headings.reviewNote: Authorizing court to grant consecutive delay extensions of up to 90 days each upon renewed application.

headings.title: Service of notice and statutory disclosure upon expiration of delay
headings.reviewNote: Requiring service of copy of process and statutory explanation notice upon expiration of delay period.

headings.title: Customer notice following emergency access to financial records
headings.reviewNote: Requiring service of emergency access notice on customer as soon as practicable following emergency obtaining.

headings.title: Filing and disclosure of papers related to notice delay request
headings.reviewNote: Requiring delay application papers to be filed in court and permitting disclosure to customer upon petition.

entries.reviewSummary: Reviewed all six subsections (including statutory post-delay and emergency-access notice forms) and 1989 enactment note; confirmed delay grounds, 90-day/indefinite duration, extensions, and paper disclosure headings.

headings.title: Customer motion to quash subpoena or action to enjoin government access
headings.reviewNote: Detailing customer procedure to file motion to quash within 10 days of service or 14 days of mailing.

headings.title: Government authority response and protective order provisions
headings.reviewNote: Permitting government response and authorizing court to enter protective orders and conduct proceedings.

headings.title: Standard for judicial determination and orders enforcing or quashing process
headings.reviewNote: Establishing standard of proof to enforce or quash process based on inquiry legitimacy and record relevance.

headings.title: Appeals governed by Missouri rules of civil procedure
headings.reviewNote: Directing appeals of challenge orders to be conducted under Missouri rules of civil procedure.

headings.title: Prompt notification to customer if no legal proceeding is contemplated
headings.reviewNote: Requiring notice to customer if no action contemplated or status reporting to court after 180 days.

headings.title: Exclusive judicial remedy to challenge financial record disclosures
headings.reviewNote: Establishing statutory challenge procedures as sole judicial remedy available to customer to oppose disclosure.

headings.title: Preservation of existing financial institution challenge rights
headings.reviewNote: Clarifying section does not enlarge or restrict financial institution rights to challenge record requests.

entries.reviewSummary: Reviewed all seven subsections and 1989 enactment note; confirmed 10/14-day motion to quash, protective orders, enforcement/quash standard, appeals, 180-day status notice, exclusive customer remedy (citing §§ 408.655 and 408.675–408.700), and institution challenge rights.

headings.title: Interagency transfer of financial records conditioned on relevance finding
headings.reviewNote: Conditioning transfer of financial records to another agency on written finding of law enforcement relevance.

headings.title: Fourteen-day customer notice requirement following interagency transfer
headings.reviewNote: Requiring transferring agency to send notice of transfer and statutory purpose to customer within 14 days.

headings.title: Court-ordered delay of customer notice regarding interagency transfer
headings.reviewNote: Authorizing transferring or receiving agency to obtain court order delaying transfer notice to customer.

entries.reviewSummary: Reviewed all three subsections (including statutory transfer notice form) and 1989 enactment note; confirmed written relevance finding, 14-day customer notice, and court-ordered delay headings.

headings.title: Interagency supervisory exchange, litigation defense, and legislative disclosure
headings.reviewNote: Authorizing supervisory report exchanges, records for litigation defense, and disclosures to legislative committees.

headings.title: Exchange of financial information between division of finance and FFIEC agencies
headings.reviewNote: Authorizing information exchanges between division of finance and federal examination council agencies.

headings.title: Disclosure of non-identifiable customer financial records
headings.reviewNote: Permitting disclosure of records and information not identified with or identifiable to a particular customer.

headings.title: Supervisory agency examination and regulatory disclosures permitted
headings.reviewNote: Authorizing financial record examination and disclosure to supervisory agencies exercising regulatory functions.

headings.title: Compliance with federal statutory reporting requirements permitted
headings.reviewNote: Permitting disclosure of financial records required to be reported under federal statutes or rules.

headings.title: Litigation discovery under court rules involving government authority
headings.reviewNote: Permitting disclosure under court rules of civil/criminal procedure where government authority is a party.

headings.title: Disclosure of financial records to department of social services
headings.reviewNote: Permits financial record disclosures to department of social services under §§ 660.325–660.355 or § 570.410 (footnote notes transfer from § 578.387 effective 1-01-17).

headings.title: Requests made by department of social services to federal parent locator service
headings.reviewNote: Exempting social services requests to federal parent locator service from privacy restrictions.

headings.title: Compliance with garnishment summons and written interrogatories
headings.reviewNote: Exempting financial institution compliance with properly served garnishment summons and interrogatories.

headings.title: Compliance with child support income withholding orders
headings.reviewNote: Exempting financial institution compliance with properly served child support income withholding orders.

headings.title: Exemption for basic customer identifying and account information
headings.reviewNote: Exempting legitimate government inquiries seeking only customer name, address, account number, and type.

headings.title: Financial institution notification of potential statutory or regulatory violations
headings.reviewNote: Authorizing institutions to notify government authorities of possible violations and granting civil immunity.

headings.title: Record disclosure for security perfection, bankruptcy, debt collection, or government loans
headings.reviewNote: Permitting disclosures incidental to perfecting liens, bankruptcy claims, debt collection, or government loans.

headings.title: Government access to public records derived from financial institutions
headings.reviewNote: Permitting government access to public records even if originally derived from a financial institution.

headings.title: Information requests under unclaimed property statutes
headings.reviewNote: Permitting government information gathering under uniform disposition of unclaimed property act.

headings.title: Inapplicability to law enforcement inquiries and personnel
headings.reviewNote: Exempting law enforcement inquiries, grand juries, and officers from privacy act restrictions.

headings.title: Inapplicability to federal agencies authorized under federal privacy act
headings.reviewNote: Exempting federal agencies authorized under federal Right to Financial Privacy Act of 1978.

headings.title: Inapplicability to state auditor access under section 29.235
headings.reviewNote: Exempting state auditor and appointed staff when obtaining information under section 29.235.

headings.title: Inapplicability to division of employment security requests under chapter 288
headings.reviewNote: Exempting division of employment security requests under Missouri employment security law.

headings.title: Inapplicability to embalmers and funeral directors preneed trust audits
headings.reviewNote: Exempting preneed funeral trust audits performed by professional registration staff under chapter 436.

entries.reviewSummary: Reviewed all twenty nonprohibited-disclosure subsections and source note flagging § 578.387 transferred to § 570.410 effective 1-01-17 (S.B. 491, 2014); confirmed all twenty headings.

headings.title: Exceptions for investigations of institutions, non-customers, and government loan programs
headings.reviewNote: Exempting investigations focused on institutions, non-customer entities, and government assistance programs.

headings.title: Certification procedures for government assistance program access
headings.reviewNote: Requiring compliance notice for program access and dispensing with certification for subsequent loan access.

headings.title: Notice of government access rights upon loan program application
headings.reviewNote: Requiring written notice of government access rights upon application for government loan or guarantee program.

headings.title: Limits on use and interagency transfer of program financial records
headings.reviewNote: Limiting records to original purpose and permitting interagency transfers for civil litigation or loan default.

headings.title: Notice to agencies of potential civil, criminal, or regulatory violations
headings.reviewNote: Permits notifying a relevant agency that records obtained under this section may relate to a potential civil, criminal, or regulatory violation.

headings.title: Institution disclosure log, customer inspection, and grand jury exemption
headings.reviewNote: Requiring disclosure logs, customer inspection rights, and exempting grand jury subpoenas.

headings.title: Emergency access to records in situations of imminent danger or flight
headings.reviewNote: Authorizing emergency record access for imminent physical injury, property damage, or flight, with sworn filing.

entries.reviewSummary: Reviewed all seven subsections and 1989 enactment note; refined subsection 5 title to reflect agency notice of potential civil, criminal, or regulatory violations rather than direct record referral.

headings.title: Civil liability, statutory damages, and attorney's fees for violations
headings.reviewNote: Imposes $1,000 statutory damages, actual damages, and discretionary costs/attorney's fees on institutions or state agencies obtaining or disclosing records unlawfully.

headings.title: Disciplinary proceedings against state agency employees for willful violations
headings.reviewNote: Mandating agency supervisory investigation and disciplinary proceedings for willful or intentional violations.

headings.title: Immunity for financial institutions relying in good faith on government notice
headings.reviewNote: Granting complete liability immunity to financial institutions making disclosures in good faith reliance on government notice.

headings.title: Exclusivity of statutory remedies and sanctions
headings.reviewNote: Establishing statutory privacy remedies and sanctions as exclusive remedies recognized by courts.

entries.reviewSummary: Reviewed all four subsections and 1989 enactment note; broadened subsection 1 title to cover both obtaining and disclosing records unlawfully and confirmed employee discipline, good-faith immunity, and exclusive-remedy headings.
